verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference and serving engine. Because it exposes an OpenAI-compatible server, it could plausibly offer configurable assistant objects, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no feature for creating or configuring task-specific custom assistants. Multi-LoRA serving, tool calling and structured outputs are developer building blocks for constructing such assistants, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks
